title: interdimensional-sleeping
description: Fixes a bug in minecraft where sleeping in a custom dimension doesn't skip the night.
body:
Fixes a bug in minecraft where sleeping in a custom dimension doesn't skip the night.
https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-188578

Add a custom dimension in the config, and the players in that dimension will start to count towards the current / max sleeping playercount.
